metadata.description: SawXu's AI coding assistant skills collection

plugins.name: weekly-report-assistant
plugins.description: Automates weekly and monthly reports (周报/月报) and KPI drafting. Reads private SeaTable records through verified API routes, aggregates monthly outcomes, analyzes GitLab or local git activity, and uses OpenCLI for verified SeaTable and Xinrenxinshi writes while defaulting to draft saves.

plugins.name: pubg-self-knock-elim-trimmer
plugins.description: Processes PUBG/NVIDIA Highlight clips that show the player themselves being knocked down or eliminated. Excludes opponent replay files such as 淘汰画面/击倒画面, detects lower-screen 击倒了你/淘汰了你 text with PaddleOCR or falls back to health-bar heuristics, keeps the seconds around that event, and merges the clips chronologically.

plugins.name: mr-pr-quality-gate
plugins.description: Use when preparing, reviewing, or submitting a GitLab MR or GitHub PR, including requests to check commit history, inspect a diff, redact sensitive data, or decide whether a change is ready for review.
